**CLOSE**
Compared to last week no market comparison due to weather.  With snow and ice on the roads and wind chills at sale time below zero, 
receipts were very low.  Supply was light with good demand.

The above USDA LPGMN price report is reflective of the majority of classes and grades of livestock offered for sale.
